biggest_catch: Your bonus is capped at $500 per calendar year, and you get nothing until the new member completes 10 debit card transactions plus two direct deposits totaling $200+ within 120 days of account opening.
catches: Referrer must have a current Purdue Federal checking account with valid contact info on file and be enrolled in paperless statements at time of referral.

Friend must be a qualifying new member: submit a valid referral code during the application process, enroll in paperless statements, make 10 member-initiated point-of-sale debit card transactions, and have two or more direct deposits totaling $200+ within 120 days of account opening.
Friend cannot have a current Purdue Federal membership or have closed one within the last 12 months.
Referrer cap: maximum $500 in aggregate referral program bonuses per calendar year (10 referrals).
$50 cash bonus credited to the referrer's checking account within 10 business days after the referred member opens their qualifying membership; bonus is tax reportable on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Businesses and Purdue Federal employees are not eligible.
